description: KKnD Xtreme / Krush Kill 'n Destroy (Beam Software 1997, GOG, via Proton)
long: Krush Kill 'n Destroy (KKnD) is a post-apocalyptic real-time strategy game pitting the surface-dwelling Survivors against the mutant Evolved. Players harvest resources, build bases and command armored units across a campaign of base-building skirmishes. The Xtreme re-release adds extra missions and higher-resolution support.
